data.name: Air Shroud
data.description: Element air; Type utility (Sp); Level 1; Burn 0 You are always surrounded by air, as air bubbleUC. As a standard action, you can accept 1 point of burn to extend the effect to a number of additional creatures equal to your Constitution modifier for 1 minute per kineticist level you possess.
